description: The plans the fake Stripe sells, seeded when it starts. A price's lookup_key is the key the platform's copilot-tier-stripe-prices flag gives it: .github/scripts/hosted_journeys_env.py builds the journeys stack's flag from this file, so the platform and the fake agree on every id. The amounts differ from the frontend's marketing prices on purpose, so a page that shows them is showing Stripe's.
